Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Histogram.description: One histogram's distribution, in the Prometheus cumulative-bucket convention: each bucket's `count` includes every observation at or below its `le`.

buckets.description: Cumulative buckets, ordered by ascending `le`. Empty when the service exposes no bucket breakdown for this histogram — count and sum still apply. Always present, for the same reason as the snapshot's own arrays.

labels.description: Dimensions the distribution is broken down by. Absent or empty when the histogram carries none.

Histogram.title: Histogram

count.description: Number of observations at or below `le`.

le.description: Upper bound of this bucket, inclusive. The final bucket conventionally reports the same value as the histogram's own `count` at whatever `le` the service treats as its ceiling.

labels.description: Dimensions the value is broken down by (e.g. `{"method": "resolve"}`). Absent or empty when the metric carries none.

name.description: The metric's stable name (e.g. `did_hosting_requests_total`). Implementation-defined; the framework imposes no vocabulary.

counters.description: Monotonically increasing totals (e.g. requests served, errors raised). Empty when the service exposes none. Always present, so a collector can tell "no counters" from "the field was dropped".

gauges.description: Point-in-time values that can rise or fall (e.g. open connections, queue depth). Empty when the service exposes none. Always present, for the same reason as counters.

histograms.description: Distributions of observed values (e.g. request latency). Empty when the service exposes none. Always present, for the same reason as counters.

takenAt.description: When the service read these values from its own instrumentation. Not the same as the envelope's issuedAt when a snapshot is cached briefly before answering.

Response.description: The VTA's current metrics snapshot. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/metrics/show/0.1#response.
Response.title: VTA Metrics — Show — response payload
